allow: PowerShell(if \($env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY\) { "Session env var: SET \(starts with $\($env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.Substring\(0,12\)\)...\)" } else { "Session env var: not set" }; "User-level: " + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY','User'\) -ne $null; "Machine-level: " + \([Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY','Machine'\) -ne $null\))

PowerShell($profiles = @\($PROFILE.CurrentUserAllHosts, $PROFILE.CurrentUserCurrentHost, "$env:USERPROFILE\\.bashrc", "$env:USERPROFILE\\.bash_profile", "$env:USERPROFILE\\.profile"\); foreach \($p in $profiles\) { if \(Test-Path $p\) { $hits = Select-String -Path $p -Pattern 'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY' -SimpleMatch; if \($hits\) { "$p :"; $hits | ForEach-Object { "  line $\($_.LineNumber\): $\($_.Line.Trim\(\)\)" } } else { "$p : clean" } } else { "$p : \(does not exist\)" } })
